The modules are in place under `/output`. I’m verifying them against the executable now, including help/error paths and a mix of valid and invalid Bech32 inputs, before I close this out.

run_case() {
  name="$1"
  shift
  /workspace/dataset/test2_executable "$@" >"$tmpdir/exe.out" 2>"$tmpdir/exe.err"
  exe_code=$?
  node /output/test2.mjs "$@" >"$tmpdir/node.out" 2>"$tmpdir/node.err"
